description.value: Dawson Co-op is a member-owned co-operative supermarket serving Dawson Creek and the surrounding northern BC communities of Chetwynd, Tumbler Ridge, and Rolla. As a full-service community grocery store, it offers the kind of provisioning stop a long-distance touring cyclist needs before tackling the remote roads of this region. The co-op model means local ownership and community reinvestment, giving it a distinct character compared to chain supermarkets.
